title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: An 8-foot Bigfoot sighting was reported in Voluntown, Connecticut by Kevin Klimas on July 5.
The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization has verified 126 Bigfoot sightings in New England since 1994.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett states there is no scientific evidence supporting Bigfoot's existence.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, died last month at age 86.
Margo wrote the 'Dear Prudence' column for Slate and 'Dear Margo' for The Boston Globe.
Author recalls Margo's lesson to find happiness after loss and shared personal anecdotes.

title: Red Sox bats, Payton Tolle’s 14 strikeouts stifle Athletics, 13-1
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Payton Tolle struck out 14 batters, leading the Boston Red Sox to a 13-1 win over the Oakland Athletics.
The Red Sox extended their winning streak to nine games and improved their record to 64-51.
Boston's offense produced 15 hits, including a five-run second inning, against Athletics pitcher Jake Perkins.

title: A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez continue sharpening each other’s games at Patriots training camp
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Patriots' A.J. Brown and Christian Gonzalez engage in competitive matchups at training camp, improving each other's skills.
Christian Gonzalez, known for his professionalism, uses trash talk with Brown to prepare for facing top receivers.
A.J. Brown anticipates a strong 2026 season with Drake Maye, after surpassing 1,000 receiving yards in 2025.

title: New Red Sox catcher Adley Rutschman to begin rehab assignment this weekend
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Adley Rutschman to start rehab assignment with Triple-A Worcester Red Sox on Saturday due to wrist inflammation.
Rutschman acquired from Baltimore in exchange for three prospects and Carlos Narvaez; last played on July 18.
Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy unsure of Rutschman's exact return to major league games.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'You, Me & Tuscany' starring Halle Bailey and Regé-Jean Page is streaming on Peacock.
'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' sequel series can be watched on Paramount+.
'Ted Lasso' Season 4 featuring Jason Sudeikis is available on Apple TV.

title: Could Garrett Crochet return to Red Sox in a bullpen role?
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Garrett Crochet has been sidelined since late April due to shoulder and lat injuries.
Red Sox interim manager Chad Tracy suggests Crochet may return as a reliever in 2026.
Crochet is open to any role that aids the team, leaving final decisions to the front office.

title: Lost a python? Boston Animal Care and Control might have it.
author: Heather Alterisio
bullets: A ball python named 'Tippy' was found in a community garden on Ellington Street, Dorchester.
Residents reported the snake was left in a cage by an unknown individual, prompting a call to 311.
Boston Animal Care and Control is caring for the snake and seeking information from the public.

title: Tommy DeVito bests Drake Maye, and other takeaways from Patriots’ training camp scrimmage
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Tommy DeVito led Team Blue to a 22-15 victory over Drake Maye's Team White in Patriots' training scrimmage.
DeMario Douglas excelled for Team Blue, recording six catches, two touchdowns, including a 50-yard reception.
Patriots' Mike Vrabel shared injury updates on players like Will Campbell and Brenden Schooler, noting cautious recoveries.

title: A closer look at Harwich, voted the best town on Cape Cod by Boston.com readers
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich, on Cape Cod, was voted the best town by 850 Boston.com readers in an informal poll.
The town features 11 miles of shoreline along Nantucket Sound and Pleasant Bay and more than 20 beaches.
Key attractions include Saquatucket Harbor, Cape Cod Lavender Farm, and daily oyster specials at The Port Restaurant & Bar.
